rules-live-in-the-harness.reading: Everything built here is for the harness, used on itself: every rule he gives is cemented in the harness, in its documents and in the files that make it act, here and in every project that installs it, because what stays in memory is forgotten. Each proposal is judged both as this project's development and as the harness in production in other projects; a gap is solved by building it, ourselves or on another solution; problems seen in any session are measured and analysed as findings to improve the harness. Since the models are Anthropic's and Codex is only an outside reviewer of what is done and of a project's code, Claude works from a root CLAUDE.md that imports AGENTS.md, and AGENTS.md keeps what a reviewer needs (diet D3, F8's S3): a rule's prose home is a line of either file, no longer AGENTS.md alone. The guard's refusal of a feedback note without a home (rule:memory-feedback-home) is its sensor.
